description: This Java class defines a custom JSP tag (OrderProductDownloadUrlTag) used to generate a download URL for an order product within an e-commerce application. It constructs the URL based on the merchant store, order ID, and product download details, utilizing utility methods and request attributes.

classes.name: OrderProductDownloadUrlTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag for generating a download URL for a product in an order, based on store data and download details.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Generates the download URL using request attributes and utility methods, then outputs it to the JSP page.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Ends the tag processing, allowing the rest of the page to continue.

methods.name: getProductDownload
methods.description: Getter for the product download object.

methods.name: setProductDownload
methods.description: Setter for the product download object.
